status: Original 30 parity rows retained, plus eight pending EffectCraft UI-category rows. Source findings are not native integration/runtime/human acceptance.
scope: Eleven historical poet-*craft roots plus additional EffectCraft source at C:/github/storytold/effectcraft-main. Representative coverage only, not complete UI parity.
governing_contract: ../poet-craft-consolidation.md sections 3-6 and ../poet-comprehensive-authoring-review.md; internal Poet functionality, not independent suite products.
manifest_inventory_note: Existing source snapshot enumerates 324 manifests across eleven repos (271 crate-tree candidates). Those are manifest candidates, not UI function counts or validated dependencies.
common_target_contract: Poet unified interface: existing observer/agent Construct scope and selected project context + suitable Manifold + ContentContainer and current selected-document/part context; same native session/source revision; Tool Chest/command palette/contextual controls and inspector/timeline as applicable. Integrate features into Poet, not separate app shells.
coverage_caveats: Every individual command id/alias, menu entry, panel/module, gesture/modifier/focus transition, shortcut, context menu, dialog, view/state, and accessibility behavior still needs a lossless row.
UI parity pages are source-maintained estimates with different dates/targets/methods; their percentages are not combined or treated as proof.
No source history/dirty-state baseline, full file list, full dependency graph, build, app execution, GUI acceptance, or matching interaction study was done in this inventory.
Selected file indexes are real source units but not complete UI source-family inventories; generated/ignored/local-only plan files may contain additional behavior.
All feature dispositions remain pending until a Poet target control is implemented and verified against source behavior and persistence/accessibility contracts.

coverage_family_rows.disposition_basis: Source/docs indexed; no end-to-end migration or parity evidence established by this inventory.
